g.text: A high alert rate is useful only with a low false-alarm cost
Each point is one fixed method, not a threshold-swept ROC curve. Detection averages the 12 equally weighted group-share/shift cells at the stated
batch size (480 streams); false alarms use 250 null streams. Real-world case frequencies may differ. Point overlap is possible; all values are in
